author: Bloodoh
body:
Hey there! today i will introduce a map that i have been waiting a lot for it, i wanted to make a really great map, then, i asked to the builders (Xuph, Ryan and AbusiveUser) to help me. They did a great job, credits for them 

Album:  http://imgur.com/a/z756S

Download: Only map devs can request for it, on slack. 


Islands:
  • Spawn Islands: You will find 8 islands with 3 chests.
  • Bonus Islands: You will find 8 islands with 1 chest and a flag for each island. 
  • Middle Island: You will find 4 chests in Middle and 1 hidden chest.



Creators: Bloodoh
Contributors: Xuph, roadmanryan and AbusiveUser
Server hosted by: Bloodoh
Gamemode: Sky Wars
Recommended Size:
  • FFA : 8 players
I will appreciate the feedback.
